name: Deposits & Partial Payments for WooCommerce – Deposet
author: Aethonic

sections.description:
Deposet is a powerful WooCommerce extension that allows customers to pay deposits on products and complete payments later. Perfect for high-value items, pre-orders, or custom products.

Features

  • Global Deposit Settings – Set default deposit amounts (fixed or percentage) for all products
  • Product-Level Control – Override global settings for individual products
  • Category-Based Rules – Apply specific deposit rules to product categories
  • Force Deposits – Require customers to pay deposits (disable full payment option)
  • Payment Plans – Create custom payment plans with multiple installments
  • User Role Restrictions – Disable deposits for specific user roles
  • Login Requirements – Optionally require login to use deposit feature
  • Stock Management – Choose when to reduce stock (deposit or full payment)
  • Payment Gateway Control – Disable specific payment gateways for deposit orders
  • Email Notifications – Automated emails for deposit confirmation, payment reminders, and final payment
  • My Account Integration – Customers can view and pay remaining balances from their account
  • Refund Support – Properly handle refunds for deposit orders
  • WooCommerce Compatible – Works with latest WooCommerce hooks and filters

How It Works

  1. Enable deposits globally or per product
  2. Customers choose between deposit or full payment on product pages
  3. Deposit amount is charged at checkout
  4. Remaining balance tracked in order details
  5. Customers pay remaining balance from My Account page
  6. Automated email reminders for upcoming payments
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/deposet/ directory, or install through WordPress plugins screen
  2. Activate the plugin through ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Navigate to Deposet → Settings to configure global settings
  4. Enable deposits on individual products or categories
  5. Test the checkout process with a deposit-enabled product
